market_summary: Overall Sentiment: Cautiously optimistic, with a bias toward a new leg higher. The checklist for an uptrend resumption has been completed (close above 21/50-day, low above it, three days closing above), and the S&P 500 is days away from a power trend. The low of the August 4th follow-through day is the line in the sand on a closing basis. "The market right now looks set up like it's just starting another leg higher" (Webby).

SNDK.technical_action: Bouncing off lows but still down 46% from highs. Massive post-earnings volatility.
SNDK.story: Poster child for AI memory. Blowout earnings (13,434% EPS growth) couldn’t stop the crash. Likely needs months of base-building.

MU.technical_action: Held up better than SNDK (down 30% from highs). RS line is stabilizing but still damaged.
MU.story: AI memory leader. Fundamentally spectacular, but technically broken. Needs time to repair.

DELL.technical_action: High-tight flag breakout attempt failed again. Wide and loose, 100-point swings. Exited on a downside reversal.
DELL.story: AI server. A frustrating stock; every breakout attempt has been chopped. Will keep watching.

LLY.technical_action: Multiple failed breakouts, unable to hold gains. Consistently gets worn out and stopped out.
LLY.story: Weight-loss drug giant. A rotation play that “just has not been working” with tight swing-trading stops.

SOXX.technical_action: Sold on July 1st, avoiding a massive drawdown. A good sell, but the prior whip was costly.
SOXX.story: Chip ETF. Symbolic of the sector's damaging volatility in early July.

UPRO.technical_action: Core position, acting as ballast. ATR of 3.27%, very manageable.
UPRO.story: 3x Leveraged S&P 500 ETF. The primary vehicle for the "market call."

TQQQ.technical_action: Core position. Provides broad tech exposure without single-stock risk.
TQQQ.story: 3x Leveraged Nasdaq 100 ETF. Part of the "ballast" for tech exposure.

VLO.technical_action: Webby bought personally; looks great but subject to headline risk on oil/geopolitics.
VLO.story: Oil refiner. A strong chart in a strong group, but one tweet away from a shakeout.

CAKE.technical_action: Broke out perfectly on June 5th, the worst day for the rest of the portfolio. Extended quickly.
CAKE.story: Restaurant/leisure. A missed opportunity; Webby regrets not buying due to being on the defensive.
